evidence: mobile-native/androidApp/src/main/java/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/navigation/Navigation.kt:493 — the Screen.CreateListing composable wires CreateListingScreen's onSubmit to a hardcoded stub: `onSubmit = { _ -> Result.failure(NotImplementedError("Wire to listing API")) }`. Every submit of the realtor Create-Listing form therefore fails unconditionally. This is the skill's Kotlin pattern 'todo!()/unimplemented reachable from a production path' and 'no-op stub' — it is live in the committed navigation graph, not behind a flag.

Reachability traced end-to-end (confidence HIGH): Navigation.kt:461 Screen.MyListings composable renders MyListingsScreen with `onCreateClick = { navController.navigate(Screen.CreateListing.route) }` (Navigation.kt:484), which routes to the composable at 490-496. So any realtor who opens 'My Listings' and taps the create button reaches this stub. CreateListingScreen.kt:41 declares `onSubmit: suspend (CreateListingInput) -> Result<Unit>` and at :109/:121 invokes it then handles `onSuccess = { onCreated() }`, with the failure path surfacing a generic `R.string.error_network` message (CreateListingScreen.kt:92). Net user-visible effect: a realtor fills out the entire validated form (title/city/price with inline validation at :198/:226/:245), taps submit, and always gets a misleading 'network error' — the feature is non-functional and the error message mis-attributes the cause.

Root-cause confirmation that this is an incomplete feature, not just an unwired call: PortalListingsRepository.kt exposes only `listMyListings` (:40), `getListingAnalytics` (:74), and `getPortfolioAnalytics` (:111) — there is NO create-listing method anywhere in shared/commonMain (grep for create-listing repository methods returns none; the only `fun create(` is ListingDetailViewModel.kt:243, an unrelated VM factory). So the stub cannot be fixed by swapping in an existing call; a repository method (and likely the reality-server endpoint + generated client surface) must be added.

Severity MEDIUM (+2): user-facing realtor feature is non-functional in production, but it fails gracefully via Result.failure (handled by the screen) rather than crashing, so no data loss / no hard crash — hence +2, not +3. Confidence HIGH: the unreachable-success path and the missing repository method are both statically confirmed and the navigation reachability is fully traced from an entry screen. Fix scope: add create-listing to PortalListingsRepository wired to the reality-server realtor API, then replace the Navigation.kt:493 lambda with a real suspend call (plus a matching test alongside the existing PortalListingsRepositoryTest.kt).
